pbr_definition: PBR = I_peak / mean(I over fiber support minus the 3x3 window centred on the peak); I_peak = brightest pixel within pbr_peak_search_radius_px of the target; support = fiber core disk (image plane) or NA disk (Fourier plane)
enhancement_definition: eta = mean(I over target window) / mean(I over fiber support minus target window); support = fiber core disk (image plane) or NA disk (Fourier plane)
